title: Media library
idea: Media library: Asset grid and inspector share selected media metadata
audience: People who need to manage media within a desktop surface.
avoidWhen: Assets have no meaningful visual content
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic collection layout through its manage media priority and explicit commitment contract: Previewing never mutates the source asset
navigation: Media library keeps the current manage media context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Asset grid and inspector share selected media metadata
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to manage media; users curate many related assets
composition.priority: Previewing never mutates the source asset

imagery.role: Support the actual manage media context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Switch to list view without losing selection
Respect window resizing, keyboard navigation and persistent document/workspace context.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the media library structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no manage media content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Previewing never mutates the source asset
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized manage media content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Previewing never mutates the source asset
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active manage media context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure representative large documents/collections and resize interaction on target OS.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate with browser study renders. Automated browser checks are recorded in evals/specimen-review.json. No independent visual comparison, task study or native runtime verification; remains draft. The illustration/task content demonstrates composition and does not prescribe every linked palette or font.
